surveyed.source: Backlog destination "Mahatma Gandhi" (extract_landmarks_37868198) on the median of the Churchill-laan; the walking bronze, the limestone block with its MAHATMA GANDHI plate, the cobble circles, benches and hedge read from Wikimedia Commons photographs (Ceescamel CC BY-SA 4.0; Antony Antony CC BY 2.0; Evanherk CC BY-SA 3.0) and 2018-2022 panoramas that show the statue small from both carriageways; the facing (90 degrees, +-30, along the carriageways) and all sizes are estimates

attribution.title: Mahatma Gandhi statue (Churchill-laan) - reconstruction from photographs
attribution.author: Map Recall; sculpture by Gautam Pal (1990); figure reconstructed from photographs by Antony Antony, Ceescamel
attribution.modifications: Figure reconstructed (TRELLIS.2 multi-view) from Wikimedia Commons photographs: "Statue of Gandhi, Amsterdam.jpg" by Antony Antony (CC BY 2.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Statue_of_Gandhi,_Amsterdam.jpg); "Gandhi (Amsterdam) (1).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gandhi_(Amsterdam)_(1).jpg); "Gandhi (Amsterdam) (2).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gandhi_(Amsterdam)_(2).jpg); "Gandhi (Amsterdam) (3).jpg" by Ceescamel (CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gandhi_(Amsterdam)_(3).jpg). Decimated to about 6,000 triangles per figure in the kit's material, no photo colour; plinth, pier and setting are the original low-poly kit model. Provenance: scripts/sculptures/rebuild-sources/gandhi-churchill-laan.json.
